'''GG-15-7''' was a [[TIE pilot]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] GG-15-7 was part of a TIE pilot unit that guarded a statue of Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] installed in front of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during that year's [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] celebrations.

==Behind the scenes==
GG-15-7 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He made appearances during the Empire Day live events of [[2009]].
